title: IMI MURI IZWI
lyrics:
SONG 01:IMI MURI IZWI

		O Bright, Eternal One
Quam Dialecta, 218

1.
Imi muri izwi

Rakasika mwenje

Nayo mvonga mvonga

Ikave rufaro

2.
Nomukutambudzwa ,

Makamutsurudza

Mwoyo yavatendi,

Vakakushumirai.

3.
Izwi rakavanda,

Tokuona zvino

Napatinofamba,

Kristu, ari pano.

4.
Togara maari,

Iye wokudenga;

Ngatimutsvagei,

Dakara tamuda.

5.
O, Ishe, mupenyu,

Mwoyo yodudzira

Runako rwenyu, ‘She,

Nokubwinya kwenyu.

Catherine  Baird  ( 18 96 -19 84 )

title: IMI MURI RUDEKARO
lyrics:
SONG 02:IMI MURI RUDEKARO

		Thou Hidden Source of Calm Repose Wells, 318

1.Imi muri rudekaro

 Rwakavanzika murudo; 

 Chipotero kuvavengi  

 Ndofadzwa kana muneni.

 Muzvitadzo, mukunyadzwa,
 
 Ndovanzwa nemi, jesu, ‘She.

2.Zita renyu, ruponiso, 

Rondifadza pakudenga; 

Rounza simba, rugare,

 Norudo rusingapere; 

 Muzita renyu ndowana 

 Kuregererwa, noutsvene.

3.Jesu muri zvose zvangu
 
Pazororo, mukurwadzawa, 

Murapi wemwoyo wangu; 

Mukurwa, ndichazorodzwa 

Mondifadza mberi kwemhandu,

 Ndowana korona yangu.  

4.Mukushaya, mondigutsa,

Muutera, mopa simba;

 Ndosunungurwa majoto, ,

 Mwenje, mberi kwomuvengi; 

 Ndichadana, mogadzira ,

 Upenyu hwangu kudenga 

   Charles Wesley (1707-88)

title: MWARI MUCHENJERI
lyrics:
SONG 03:MWARI MUCHENJERI

		Immortal, Invisible
St. Denio, 569

1.
Mwari Muchenjeri, hamuonekwi

Makavanzwa kwatiri muchiedza,

Makaropafadzwa Dombo rekare,

samasimba, M’kundi, tokurumbidza.

2.
Makanyararisa kunge chiedza,

Hamuperi, munotonga nesimba;

Ndurano yenyu, makomo marefu,

Pam’soro pamakore ane rudo.

3.
Munopa upenyu kuna zvose;

Muri mupenyu hwezvinhu zvose;

Todenhera semashizha emiti;

Tofa  topera,asi hamusanduke.

4.
Baba wokubwinya, muri chiedza

Ngirozi dzokudza, dzovanza zviso;

Tokukudzai, tiyamurei kuona

Chiedza chitsvene chinokuvanzai.

Walter Chalmers Smith (1824-1908)

title: MWARI NGAAKUDZWE
lyrics:
SONG 04: MWARI NGAAKUDZWE

To God Be The Glory
To God be the glory, 576

1.
Mwari ngaakudzwe nebasa rake,

Norudo wakatipa mwana wake,

Wakafira kudzikinura zvivi,

Nokuzarura suo reupenyu.

CHORUS 

Kudza ;She! Kudza ‘She!

Nyika ngaimunzwe;

Kudza ;She! Kudza ‘She!

Vanhu ngavafare;

Uyai kuna Baba nokuna Jesu,

Kudzai nezvakaitirwa isu.

2.
Ruregerero rutsvene rweropa,

Kumutendi chivimbiso chaMwari

Mutadzi mukuru akangotenda,

Owana ruregerero rwaJesu.

3.
Wakatidzidzisa zvinhu zvikuru

Norufaro rwedu muna Jesu, ‘She,

Rufaro rwedu ruchave rukuru,

Kana toona Jesu mumakore.

Fanny Crosby (1820-1915)

title: MWARI SAMASIMBA
lyrics:
SONG 05:MWARI SAMASIMBA

		Jehovah Is Our Strength
Majesty, 226; St John , 228; Millenium, 227

1.
Mwari Samasimba,

Iye rumbo rwedu;

Naye tichakunda

Vavengi vakuru.

Satani anorwa nhando

Nokuti Mwari NdiMambo.

2.
Ishe bako redu

Achazongodaro;

Wakamisa isu

Norwake rubato.

Vavengi vanorwa nhando,

Nokuti Mwari ndiMambo .

3.
Jehovah Mufudzi,

Anoziva zvose;

Isu tiri hwai

Tichafudzwa naye.

Chivi norufu inhando,

Nokuti Mwari ndiMambo.

4.
Mwari baba wedu,

Tiri vana vake;

Tichazongodaro,

Haangatisiye.

Masimba ose inhando,

Nokuti Mwari ndiMambo.

attr. Samuel Barnard

title: MWARI WAMARUDZI OSE
lyrics:
SONG 06:MWARI WAMARUDZI OSE

		Thou Hidden Source of Calm Repose Wells, 318

1.
Mwari wamarudzi ose ,

Zvino tikomborerei;,

Mumwoyo tigadzirire,,

Uye moto wenyu;,

Ropafadzai Hondo yedu,,

Tizadzei namasimba.,

2.
Tizadzei noMweya M’tsvene,,

Mauto ashambidzwe;,

Nemi satani aparadzwe,,

Nenyika iponiswe;,

Ropafadzwai Hondo yedu,,

Titumei kwamunoda.,

3.
Utsvene hwenyu, tipei ,,

Ngatizadzwe nesimba;,

Hondo yedu ngaitende,,

Nom’ towo wokukunda;,

Ropafadzai Hondo yedu,,

Muve rudziviriro.,
,

4.
Ropafadzai vafundisi,,

Vatungamiri vose;,

Ropafadzaiwo vadzoki,,

Mauto edu ose,,

Ropafadzai Hondo yedu,

Matama tiparidze.,
,

William James Pearson (1832-92)

title: MWARI WEDENGA NAPASI
lyrics:
SONG 07:MWARI WEDENGA NAPASI

		O Lord Of Heaven And Earth
Troyte, 470; Almsgiving, 469, G

1.
Mwari wedenga napasi,

Ngakuve norurumbidzo;

Toratidza rudo sei:

Mupi wazvose.

2.
Runyararo rwemudzimba

Namakomborero ose;

Tinotenda, tokurumbidzai;

Mupi wazvose.

3.
Makapira Mwana wenyu,

Kunesu tose vepasi;

Mwana wenyu mumwechete:

Makapa zvose.

 4.
Munopa Mweya Mutsvene,

Mweya worudo nesimba;

Nengoni dzakawandisa,

Nokwatiriwo.

5.
Mukununurwa muzvivi,

Ndiyo nzira youdenga ;

Baba varumbidzwe zvino;

Mupi wazvose.

Christopher Wordsworth  (1807-85)

title: MWARI WEDU MUDZIVIRIRI
lyrics:
SONG 08:MWARI WEDU MUDZIVIRIRI

		A Mighty Fortress Is Our Lord
Ein’Feste Burg, 640

1.
Rusvingo rusingakundwe;

Muyamuri mumirove

Yedambudzo roupenyu.

Sezvo mhandu yedu

Satani aripo,

Ane simba guru,

Noruvengo rwake,

Haana wezera pasi.

2.
Kuvimba neredu simba

Kunotiita tikundwe,

Dai tisina M’ponisi

Watakapiwa naMwari,

Wobvunza, ndiani?

Ndiye Jesu Kristu;

Ishe wesabata,

Asingapinduke,

Achakunda mukurwa.

3.
Nyangwe kune madhimoni

Anoda kutinyengera;

Hatitye, Mwari anoda

Tikunde neidi rake.

Muchinda werima

Hatimudederi,

Ane hasha nhando,

Hona! achakundwa.

Izwi duku romukunda

4.
Izwi rine simba chose,

Kwete, haringambomiswa.

Mweya, nezvipo ndezvedu

Zviri kurutivi rwedu.

Upfumi nehama,

Upenyu hwopera,

Vangatiuraye;

Chokwadi chomira,

Umambo hwake narinhi.

Martin Luther (1483-1545)
trs Frederick Henry Hedge (1805-90)

title: MWEYA WANGU, RUMBIDZA ‘SHE
lyrics:
SONG 09:MWEYA WANGU, RUMBIDZA ‘SHE

	Praise My Soul The King of Heaven
Blessed Jesus, 240; Praise My Soul
The King of Heaven, 422

1.
Mweya wangu, rumbidza ‘She

Pasi petsoka dzake;

Wanunurwa, waponiswa,

Chiimba mbiri yake;

Murumbidze! Murumbidze!

Kudza ‘She asingafe.

2.
Mukudze nengoni dzake

Kune vari munhamo,

woranga, wovaponisa,

Vose vakarasika;

Murumbidze!Murumbidze!

Mwari anovimbika.

3.
Sababa wotichengeta,

Kana tisina simba;

Wochengeta mumaoko,

Torwirwa kuvavengi,

Murumbidze! Murumbidze!

Nengoni dzoyerera.

4.
Ngirozi dzomurumbidza,

Dzotarisana naye,

Zuva, mwedzi, zvonamata

Zvigereko kudenga;

Murumbidze! Murumbidze!

Rumbidzai Wenyasha.

Henry Francis Lyte (1793-1857)

title: NAMATAI MAMBO ANORUBWINYO
lyrics:
ANORUBWINYO

		O Worship The King, All Glorious
Houghton, 533; Hanover, 531; Landate
Dominum, 534

1.
Namatai Mambo anorubwinyo;

Imbai nesimba rudo rwakwe;

Iye mudzviviriri nenhowo yedu,

Agere muutsvene hune mbiri

2.
Imbai zvesimba nengoni dzake,

Ane nguvo, chiedza chedenga,

Kutsamwa kwake, ‘She, kunotinhira,

Nzira yake ine rima padutu.

3.
Nyika izere nezvishamiso,

Nesimba rake, ‘She, richigere,

Rakadaro risingasandurwe,

Zve, wakarikomberedza negungwa.

4.
Ruchengeto rwake rwakakosha,

Rwuri mumhepo, nomuchiedza;

Rwobva mugomo rwopinda mubani,

Rwuri m ‘dova nemvura inonaya.

5.
Vana venyika vasina simba,

Maari tinoisa ruvimbo,

Tsitsi nomutsa wake hazvigume,

Musiki, mudzikinuri, nehama.

6.
Samasimba, rudo rwakadzama,

Ngirozi dzichiimba kudenga;

Zvisikwa zvenyika zvisina simba,

Norukudzo zvichakuimbirawo.

Robert Grant (1779-1839)

title: NGAARUMBIDZWE WEDENGA
lyrics:
Praise To The Holiest In The Height
Gerontius, 89; Richmond, 125

1.
Ngaarumbidzwe wedenga

Napasi pakudze,

Namazwi ake matsvene,

Nenzira dzeidi.

2.
Ungwaru hwaMwari wedu

Hunokunda hwose;

Kritsu wakauya kuti

Azotinunura.

3.
Adhamu wakakundika

Munyama neropa,

Asi rudo rwake Mwari,

Rwakakunda zvose.

4.
Ngaarumbidzwe wedenga,

Napasi pakudze;

Namazwi ake matsvene,

Nenzira dzeidi.

John Henry Newman (1821-77)

title: NGATITENDEI MWARI
lyrics:
Now Thank We All Our God,
Now thank we all our god, 752

1.
Ngatitendei Mwari

Nemwoyo yedu yose;

Anezvishamiso

Zvinoifadza nyika;

Kubva pauduku,

Watikomborera,

Nezvipo zverudo

Ndezvedu narinhi.

2.
Upfumi hwaMwari

Ngahuve pedyo nesu;

Mwoyo ifadziswe,

Norugare kwatiri;

Tigare mungoni,

Dzititungamire,

Dzitisunungure

Pano nokudenga

3.
Ngaatendwe Mwari,

Ngaarumbidzwe Baba,

NoMwanakomana,

Naye Mweya Mutsvene;

Mwana mumwechete,

Wepasi nedenga,

Waive, achave,

Nokusingapere.

Martin Rinkart (1856-1649)
trs. Catherine Winkworth (1827-78)

title: RURIMI RWANGU, TANGISA
lyrics:
Being My Tongue, Some Heavenly Theme
Lydia, 110; Stracathro, 136

1.
Rurimi rwangu, tangisa,

Mutsa izwi, imba

Zviito nezita guru,

ZvaShe, Samasimba.

2.
Udza kuvimbika kwake,

Nesimba panyika;

Imba runako rwengoni,

Dzeizwi raMwari.

3.
Izwi rengoni nesimba

Rakasika Denga;

Rinotsigira nyenyedzi,

Rotaura zvose.

4.
Mwoyo wangu uchafara,

Nadzo tsitsi deznyu,

Nezwi iro ndinovimba

Rutendo rwogutswa.

Isaac Watts (1647-1748)

title: UMAMBO HWENYU NGAHUUYE
lyrics:
Thy Kingdom Come On Bended Knee

1.
Umambo hwenyu ngahuuye!

Tohunamatira;

Vatendi, neshungu huru,

Vanohumirira.

chorus

Kunanayira kwenguva,

NdokwaMwari, Baba;

Nyenyedzi dzinopupura

Simba nenduramo.

2.
Zuva rinopenya kwazvo,

Kunze kwotoyedza;

Shongai hanzu, vatendi,

Nguva yaswedera.

3.
Zuva rinopenya kwazvo,

Rodzima zvitadzo;

Kururama kuchamiswa,

Kuporese zvose.

4.
Ruzivo, norunyararo,

Zvichafamba kwose;

Zuva rake Mwari.

F.L. Hosmer (1840-1929)

title: MUNOTENDESEKA , O MWARI BABA
lyrics:
Great Is Thy Faithfulness.
Great is thy faithfulness, 657

1.
Munotendeseka, O Mwari Baba,

Hamuna mumvuri wesanduko,

Hamungapinduke mutsitsi dzenyu,

Saizvozvo, mogara narinhi.

 CHORUS

Munotendeseka!Munotendeseka!

Mangwanani ndogam’chira tsitsi,

Zvose zvandinoda ndopiwa nemi,

Munotendeseka, ‘She, kwandiri.

2.
Zhizha, chando napo pakukohwa,

Zuva, mwedzi, nyenyedzi pa’msoro,

Zvinosangana zvose kupupura

Kurudo rwenyu runotendeka.

3.
Toregererwa kwenguva yose,

Kuvepo kwenyu kwotungamira;

Simba ranhasi neramangwana,

Makomborero angu, zvihuru.

Thomas Obediah Chisholm (1866-1960)

title: VANHU VOSE VEPANYIKA
lyrics:
All People That On Earth Do Dwell
Old Hundredth, 38 Ab; Tallis, 41 G

1.
Vanhu vose vepanyika,

Imbai mose kuna ‘She;

Munamatei nokutya,

Farisai mberi kwake.

2.
Uyu Mambo, ndiye Mwari;

Wakatisika pachake;

Anotifudza sehwai,

Tiriwo vedanga rake.

3.
Ngatipinde mberi kwake,

Norukudzo norufaro;

Tirumbidze zita rake,

Zvakakodzera kudaro.

4.
Torumbidzirei Ishe?

Azere tsitsi neidi;

Chokwadi chake chiripo,

Hachipinduke narinhi.

William Kethed (1594)

title: ZVISIKWA ZVAMWARI MAMBO
lyrics:
All Creatures of Our God And King
St. Francis, 45

1.
Zvisikwa zvaMwari Mambo,

Ngatiimbe pamwechete,

Hareruya!Hareruya!

Newe zuva rinopisa,

Newe mwedzi unopenya:

CHORUS

Murumbidze, Murumbidze,

Hareruya,Hareruya,

Hareruya,!

2.
Iwe mhepo une simba,

Imi makore edenga,

Murumbidze! Hareruya!

Iwe unotonga, rumbidza,

Newe manheru imbawo:

3.
Nemvura inoyerera;

Imbirawo Ishe anzwe,

Hareruya! Hareruya!

Moto une simba guru,

Wopa kudziya nomwenje:

4.
Ivhu rinotipa zvose,

Zvatinodya misi yose,

Murumbidze! Hareruya!

Namaruva nemichero,

Ngazviratidze kubwinya:

5.
Zvisikwa ngazvirumbidze,

Zvinamate norupfavo,

Murumbidze! Hareruya!

Baba, Mwana, Mweya

Varumbidzwe Hareruya

Francis of Assisi (1182-1226)

trs. William Henry Draper (1855-1933)

title: ISHE, IZWI RENYU
lyrics:
Lord Thy Word Abideth
Ravenshaw, 774

1.
Ishe, izwi renyu,

Rinotitungamira;

Kune anotenda,

Rinotiponisa,

2.
Mhandu dziri pedyo,

Tofadzwa nezwi renyu;

Rinotinyaradza,

Rinotiponesa.

3.
Mudutu renhamo,

Makore okwidiba;

Mwenje wovheneka,

Wotichengetedza.

4.
Rufarowo here,

Pamwe noupfumi,

Zvopiwa neshoko

Kunawo vatendi!

5.
Izwi rine tsitsi,

Rotsigira vapenyu;

Ndiro izwi benyu

Kwavari murufu.

6.
Dai tichiona

Utsvene hwaro shoko;

Ishe, taikutyai,

Tive pedyo nemi.

Henry Williams Baker (1821-77)

title: KUDZAI MWARI MUKURU
lyrics:
Praise The Almighty
Belmont, 76; French, 88

1.
Kudzai Mwari mukuru

Rumbidzai mose!

Wakatipa gore idzva,

Ngaarumbidzwe!

2.
Wakatichengeta iye,

Gore rapfuura;

Tose tiri mberi kwake,

Nemipiro yedu.

3.
Tinokutendai, Baba,

Nedzo tsitsi dzenyu;

Tinozvipira kwamuri

Nayo mwoyo yedu.

4.
Toda kukurumbidzai

Namabasa edu;

Toda kutevera Jesu,

Tiende kudenga.

6.
Dzose nguva dzatinadzo,

Dzive dzenyu, Ishe;

Namasimba edu ose,

Apirwe kwamuri.

Charles Wesley (1707-88)

title: KUITA KWAKE, MUSIKI
lyrics:
The Creator’s Hidden Works
French, 88

1.
Kuita kwake, Musiki,

Kwakavanda chose;

Anotipa, agotora

Vadiwa kwatiri.

2.
Mhuri yokura, yowanda,

Mapudzi matsvene;

Asi nenguva isipi,

Zvose zvoparara.

3.
Vanoverera serima

Rotiza chiedza;

Mumwe nomumwe woenda

Kuumambo hwake.

4.
Mwoyo yedu yotambudzwa,

Toshaya kuziva

kufunga kwake, Musiki,

Nesu kwopesana.

5.
Hatingazive mazano

Okuronga kwaShe;

Asi toziva, tovimba,

Zvose zvichanaka.

6.
Mwari tipeiwo simba

Kugam’chira zvose;

Nengoni, tichauyawo,

Kumusha kudenga.

Solomon M. Mutswairo (1924-)

title: MWARI ANOTISHAMISA
lyrics:
God Moves In A Mysterious Way
St’ Peter, 129; Belmont, 76; French, 88

1.
Mwari anotishamisa

Namabasa ake;

Tsoka dzake todziona

Padutu, mugungwa.

2.
Iye Mwari ane njere,

Dzisingakundike,

Dziri mumazano ake,

Nomukuda kwake.

3.
Imi vatendi shingai,

Musatye makore;

Anoda kunisa mutsa,

Nengoni dzaIshe.

4.
Regai kutonga Ishe,

Nokuziva kwenyu;

Seri kwezviito zvake

Kune ngoni zhinji.

5.
Mazano nokuda kwake

Zvinopetenuka;

Pfumvudza nyangwe yovava

Ruva royevedza.

6.
Tikasatenda toona

ZvaMwari senhando;

Asi munaiye Mwari,

Munechidudziro

William Cowper (1731-1800)

title: ZMWARI MAMBO KANA NDOFUNGIDZIRA
lyrics:
NDOFUNGIDZIRA

	O Lord, My God!

How great Thou Art!544
Mwari, Mambo, Kana ndofungidzira,

1.
Mabasa enyu anoshamisa,

Nenyenyedzi, ndonzwa nokuriridza,

Nesimba renyu guru panyika.

Kana ndofamba musango remiti,

CHORUS

Ndokuimbirai Mwari M’ponisi

Muru M ‘kuru! Mukuru sei!

Ndokuimbirai Mwari M’ponisi,

Muri M’kuru! Mukuru sei!

2.
Ndonzwa shiri dzinondifadzisa;

Ndotarisawo pasi pemakomo,

Ndonzwa hova, mhepo yofefeta.

Mwari makatipa Mwanakomana

3.
Kutifira: izvi zvoshamisa!,

Wakatakura zvivi paM’chinjikwa,

Wakafa kubvisa zvivi zvangu.

Kristu achazouya, norumuko ,

4.
Ndoenda kumusha norufaro;

Ndichamukudza nokumurumbidza,

Ndokudza Mwari, Mukuru sei!

title: MWARI MUNE SIMBA ROSE
lyrics:
God Is All-powerful

Remington, 42; Duke Street, 17; Pentecost, 40

Mwari, mune simba rose,

1.
Mwari mune simba rose

Tungamirai vafambi

Vari mumweya, mudenga

Vadzivirirwe kunjodzi.

2.
Mwari mune zano guru

Chengetai vanofamba

Nengarava dzomugungwa;

Napasi ngoro Dzemoto,

3.
Mwari Mutongi wazvose;

Podzai hasha dzemheni

Mvura zhinji ituruke.

Vanhu nenzara vasafe

4.
Mwari itai marudzi,

Asagadzire mabhomba

Zvombo zvizhinji zvouraya.

Vanhu nezviri paNyika,

5.
Mwari Itai Musiki womunhu;

Anotonga zviri pasi

Mupei gwara kuronga

Zvorudo, norunyararo.

Solomon M. Mutswairo (1924-)

title: NEMWOYO INOFARA
lyrics:
Let Us With a Gladsome Mind

Monkland 286: Theodora 297,

Nemwoyo inofara,

1.
Zvisikwa zvaMwari Mambo,

Ngatiimbe pamwechete,

Hareruya!Hareruya!

Ngaritendwe Gwayana!

Ndiri kuenda kudenga,

Ngaritendwe Gwayana!

4. Ndicharamba ndichiimba,

Ngaritendwe Gwayana!

Kuti Jesuwandifira,

Ngaritendwe Gwayana!

Hodgson Casson (1788-1851)

title: CHIVIMBISO CHAKAKOSHA
lyrics:
Precious Promise

I will guide thee, 379; Bethany, 429

1. Chivimbiso chakakosha,

Chakapiwa naMwari,

Kumufambi wakaneta:

Ndiri Mutungamiri.

Ndotungamira, ndotungamira,

Ndotungamira neziso rangu;

Nzira yose yokudenga,

Ini, ndichakutungamira.

2. Kunyange une zviedzo,

Shamwari dzinotiza;

Bata chivimbiso icho:

Neziso ndotungamira.

3. Kana makore atora

Tariro nokuvimba,

Yeuka chakavimbiswa:

Neziso ndotungamira

4. Upenyu hwava kupera,

Kana kwasviba kufa,

Mutungamiri wokudana

Neziso ndotungamira.

Nathaniel Niles (b. 1835)

title: HANDINGATYE KUNYANGE MAKORE OUYA
lyrics:
MAKORE OUYA

I Shall Not Fear

I’m in his hands, 687

1.Handingatye kunyange makore ouya:

Mwari wangu ane hanya anondinzwa,

Kunyange madutu achindivhundutsira,

Ini ndiri mumaoko ake.

Ndiri mumaoko ake;

Mune zvinouya,

Ndiri wake;

Mazuva emberi,

Akarongwa naye,

Nzira uechokwadi

Kuva naye.

2. Nyangwe ndisingaone nzira mberi kwangu,

Ndichangotevera mirayiro yake;

Ndine rutendo rwakasimba

Ini ndiri mumaoko ake.

3. Kare wakandipa zvaindikwanirawo,

Kana ndazvipira kubasa rorudo,

Ndinokahadzika nei kuti aripo

Kana ndiri mumaoko ake?

Stanley E. Ditmer

title:
NDIPEI MWOYO WOKUKUDZA O For A Heart
Martydom, 1133; Crimond, 82
lyrics:
O For A Heart

Martydom, 1133; Crimond, 82

I Shall Not Fear

I’m in his hands, 687

1. Ndipei mwoyo wokukudza

Mwari Ishe wangu;

Mwoyo wakasununngurwa

Neropa raJesu.

2. Mwoyo wakazvipfavisa,

Chitongero chaShe,

Kritsu paanotaura,

Anotonga chete.

3. Mwoyo wakazvipfavisa,

Mwoyo wechokwadi,

Usingatsaukaniswe

Naiye mugari.

4. Mwoyo unofunga zvedi,

Norudo uzere;

Mwoyo mutsvene, wetsitsi,

Semwoyo wenyu ’She.

5. Mundipe chenyu chimiro,

Uyai ’She, zvino;

Nyorai zita ’dzva pamwoyo,

Rinonzi rorudo.

Charles Wesley (1707-88) (verses)

title:
ISHE. MURI CHIPOTERO Blessed Lord, In Thee Is Refuge
Blessed lord, 410; Helsley, 417
lyrics:
Blessed Lord, In Thee Is Refuge

Blessed lord, 410; Helsley, 417

1. Ishe, muri chipotero

Kana mweya uchitya

Munogona kusimbisa

Padutu rine hasha.

Ndokutendai, ndokutendai,

Muchagarondibata.

2. Dzimwe nguva dzapfuura,

Handina kumbotenda,

Zvaasakaona meso,

Handina kuzvitenda.

Ishe Jesu, Ishe Jesu,

Ndidzidzisei kuvimba.

3.Ngandikunde nokutenda,

Ndave pakukundika;

Rutendo runosandura,

Kurwa kuve kukunda.

Ngandikunde, ngandikunde,

Ndisingazive kutya.

Herbert Howard Booth (1862-1926)

title:
JESU, MUDI WOMWEYA Jesus Lover Of My Soul
Martyn, 174 F; Hollingside, 171 Eb
lyrics:
Jesus Lover Of My Soul

Martyn, 174 F; Hollingside, 171 Eb

1.Jesu, mudi womweya,

Kana mweya uchitya;

Kwamuri ndotizira

Mvura ichi shinyira,

Mhepo ichivhuvhuta.

Ndivanzei, Muponisi,

Padutu roupenyu;

Ivai mutungamiri,

2. Rimwe bako handina,

Ndotsamira kwamuri;

Regai kundisiya,

Ngandinyaradzwe nemi.

Ndovimba nemi chete,

’She, mubatsiri wangu;

Ndidzivirire, Ishe,

Namapapiro enyu.

3. Kritstu, ndokudai chete,

Zvose zviri mamuri;

Simbisai vakaziya,

Ponesaiwo zita dzvene,

Munaro zita dzvene,

Ini, ndiri mutadzi;

Nokuipa ndizere,

Mune idi nengoni.

4. Munadzo tsitsi zhinji

kuregerera zvivi,

Rukova rwokurapa,

Rwundirape mukati,

Muri tsime ro’penyu

Ngandizadziswe nemi,

Garai mumwoyo wangu,

Imi, rinhi narinhi.

Charles Wesley (1707-88)

title:
KANA NZIRAYANGU INO RUGARE When Peace Like A River
It is well with my soul, 695
lyrics:
When Peace Like A River

It is well with my soul, 695

1.Kana nzira yangu ino rugare,

Kana zvisuwo zviripo,

Panzvimbo dzose makandidzidzisa

Kuti zvakanaka mumwoyo.

Rugare mumwoyo

(pamidza)

Runyararo mumwoyo wangu.

2. Kunyangwe satani achindinetsa,

Ndiyeuke dzose nguva;

Kristu anoziva zvandinoshaya,

Akandiparadzira ropa.

3. Kristu muri wangu, noupenyu hwangu

Kana ndasvika pakufa,

Handichazotya nokuti ipapo,

Rugare rwenyu muchandipa.

4. Ishe, togarira kuuya kwenyu,

Patichaenda kudenga;

Zvofadza sei kunzwa izwi raShe,

Richipa mwoyo kuzorora.

Horatio Gates Spafford (1828 -88)

title:
KUVIMBA NGUVA DZOSE Simply Trusting Every Day;
Trusting as the moment fly, 299
lyrics:
Simply Trusting Every Day;

Trusting as the moment fly, 299

1. Kuvimba nguva dzose

Mumatambudziko ose

Kunyange nokutsamwa

NaJesu ndinovimba.

Kuvimba nguva dzose,

Kuvimba misi yose,

Kune zvinoitika,

NaJesu ndinovimba

2. Mweya wake wopenya,

Mumwoyo une rima

Naye handichazowa,

NaJesu ndinovimba

3. Munzira ndinovimba

Murima ndoteura;

Munjozi ndomudana,

NaJesu ndinovimba

4. Muupenyu ndovimba

Murufu ndichavimba,

Kudenga ndichapinda,

NaJesu ndinovimba.

Edgar Page Stites (1836 -1921)

title:
M’PONISI JESU, ANONDISHAMISA He Hideth My Soul
He hideth my soul, 537
lyrics:
He Hideth My Soul

He hideth my soul, 537

1. Muponisi Jesu, anoshamisa,

Anondishamisa kwazvo!

Anovanza mweya wangu mudombo

Mune hova dzorudo

Anovanza mweya wangu mudombo

Riri munyika yenyota ;

Anovanza upenyu nomurudo,

Noruoko wondivanza.

2. Muponisi Jesu anoshamisa,

Mutoro wangu wobisa;

Wonditsigira, handitsukunyudzwe,

Wogarondipa masimba.

3. Wondiropafadza panguva dzose,

Ndozadzwa noMweya M’tsvene;

Ndoimba, ndofara : Rumbidza Mwari !

Iye Mununuri wangu.

Fanny Crosby (1820-1915)

title:
MUKUWADZANA, NDINOFARISA What A Fellowship
leaning on the everlasting arms, 715
lyrics:
What A Fellowship

leaning on the everlasting arms, 715

1.Mukuwadzana, ndinofarisa,

Ndotsamira maoko ake;

Ndokomborerwa norunyararo

Ndotsamira maoko ake.

Ndotsamira,

Kubva kunjodzi dzose;

Ndotsamira,

Ndotsamira maoko ake.

2. Zvinofadzisa ndiri parwendo,

Ndotsamira maoko ake;

Nzira youpenyu zuva nezuva,

Ndotsamira maoko ake.

3. Ndovhundukei, ndogotyeiko?

Ndotsamira maoko ake;

Ndokomborerwa, pedyo naIshe,

Ndotsamira maoko ake.

Elisha Albright Hoffman (1838-1929)

title:
MWARI, BABA, NDATSAUKA My God, And Father, While I Stray
Thy will be done, 14 Troyte, 470 (modified)
lyrics:
My God, And Father, While I Stray

Thy will be done, 14 Troyte, 470 (modified)

1. Mwari, Baba, ndatsauka

Kubva kumusha, murima;

Ndidzidzise kutaura:

Kuda kwenyu ngakuitwe!

2. Muchida upenyu hwangu,

Ndohwenyu, hausi hwangu;

Ndodzorera zvenyu, Jesu:

Kuda kwenyu ngakuitwe!

3. Chirwere chikaparadza

Upenyu hwangu panyika,

Ndichazoti kuna Baba:

Kuda kwenyu ngakuitwe!

4. Ropafadza mwoyo, Ishe,

Tumira Mweya Mutsvene,

Ndovimba nemi nazvose:

Kuda kwenyu ngakuitwe!

5. Kuda kwangu kuvandudzwe,

Kuti nokwenyu kunzwane,

Bisa zvisingayamure:

Kuda kwenyu ngakuitwe!

title:
NDICHIFUNGA NEZVENYAYA When I Ponder O’er The Story
A perfect trust, 459
lyrics:
When I Ponder O’er The Story

A perfect trust, 459

1.Ndichifunga nezvenyaya
,
Kukundika nenhamo;

Matambudzo noupofu,

Zvabva mukusatenda!

Kazhinji ndakundika

Nokuti handitendi.

Rwakadzikisa, rwakakurisa,

Tinochemera rutendo rwa’She.

2. Ndingashame kukundika?

Ngingashame ndichiwa?

Ndaikunda norutendo

Dai ndakatendeka ;

Ndichinge ndapererwa,

Simba rake rokunda

3. Kungoni dzisingagume,

Ndononokei’ko?

Kusimba risingagume,

Ndoreva zvangu zvose,

Pfuma yose yedenga

Norutendo ndezvangu.

4. Hungu, ’She, ndichavimbika,

Ndogara murutendo,

Ndichiziva muri pedyo,

Mondiita ndikunde;

Jesu kana muripo,

Handizotyi narinhi.

Cornelic E. Booth (1864 -1919)

title:
NDOGARA PAMHIKO DZAKRISTU MAMBO
, Standing On The Promises
Standing on the promise, 797
lyrics:
MAMBO
,

Standing On The Promises

Standing on the promise, 797

1.Ndogara pamhiko dzaKristu Mambo

Rinhi narinhi apiwe rukudzo;

Ngaarumbidzwe, ndinoimba rumbo,

Ndogara pamhiko dzaMwari

Ndinogara!

Ndogara pamhiko dzaMwari M’ponisi;

Ndinogara!

Ndogara pamhiko dzaMwari.

2. Ndogara pamhiko dzisingakundwe ,

Kana dutu nokutya zvindibate;

Nezwi benyu raMwari ndichakunda,

Ndogara pamhiko dzaMwari.

3. Ndogara pamhiko dzaKristu Ishe,

Ndasungwa norudo narinhi wose,

Nebakatwa roMweya ndingakunde,

Ndogara pamhiko dzaMwari.

4. Ndichigara pamhiko handingawe,

Mweya wondidaidza nditerere,

Pana Muponisi ndingazorodzwa,

Ndogara pamhiko dzaMwari.

5. Ndichigara pamhiko ndingaone

Kuti muropa’ro ndingashambidzwe;

Kristu akaita ndisununguke,

Ndogara pamhiko dzaMwari.

Russel Kelso Carter (1849 -1926)
